name: Memphis (Egypt)

name: Babylon
note: Rose to prominence under the Amorite dynasty; Hammurabi reigned c.1792-1750 BCE (year_start approximate)

name: Carthage
note: Traditional foundation date by Phoenician settlers from Tyre

name: Rome
note: Traditional foundation date (legendary; archaeology suggests settlement earlier)

name: Athens
note: Continuously inhabited for millennia; year_start is a rough marker of Mycenaean-era importance

name: Persepolis
note: Construction began under Darius I c.518 BCE

name: Chang'an (Xi'an)
note: Capital of the Western Han dynasty from its founding in 202 BCE

name: Constantinople
note: Dedicated by Constantine I in 330 CE; now Istanbul

name: Mecca
note: Year marks the Hijra; Mecca was a settlement long before

name: Samarkand
note: Ancient city (Afrasiab); year_start is a rough approximation

name: Cordoba
note: Became capital of the Umayyad emirate in 756

name: Angkor
note: Jayavarman II proclaimed kingship in 802 CE

name: Venice
note: Traditional date of the first doge (697 CE)

name: Tenochtitlan
note: Traditional foundation date; site is now Mexico City
